gate.note: Gate settings are read from the repo config at run time, not from the stored state, so wording changes apply on the next run.
gate.question: Is this an ordinary {session} on which it is reasonable to sell far out-of-the-money S&P 500 index puts?
gate.yes: nothing unusual: normal volatility for the times and no major scheduled shock before the option expires
gate.no: something is off: unusual fear or volatility, a large gap, or a major scheduled shock (Fed decision, CPI, jobs report) before the option expires
gate.shock_question: Could the event in this headline plausibly make the US stock market fall sharply within the next day?
gate.shock_yes: a war, disaster, financial crisis or market breakdown that could hit US stocks hard and fast
gate.shock_no: routine news, or a problem too slow or too local to move the whole market within a day

approvals.note: test = stage a non-marketable 1-lot instruction and delete it at the close run; live = stage the real order (live mode only); off = dashboard button only
